stemMd: A tank initially contains 90 litres and loses 6 litres per minute at a constant rate. After how many minutes will 30 litres remain?
explanationMd: The tank must lose 90−30=60 litres. At 6 litres per minute, this takes 10 minutes; the linear equation is 90−6t=30.

distractorRationale.c: This is the time to empty the tank.
distractorRationale.d: This adds the two volumes before dividing.
distractorRationale.a: This divides the final amount by the loss rate instead of using the amount lost.
